projects.name: Medical Clinic Management Platform

projects.name: Aspros Diesel Management System

projects.problem_solved: Agricultural operations needed accurate diesel tracking, machinery monitoring, inventory control, and route visibility to detect inefficiencies and manage fuel consumption.
projects.technical_overview: Implemented mobile GPS tracking systems, synchronization pipelines, inventory logic, geospatial visualizations, role-based workflows, reporting systems, Android-specific background processing, offline queues, and operational dashboards.
architecture_notes: Operational dashboards connected to mobile telemetry
automation_or_ai_usage: Project heavily developed with Codex AI assistance
engineering_challenges: Reliable GPS tracking in Android background modes
